verdict.rationale: Tavily is API-first and documents its public REST API endpoint by endpoint: search, extract (batch up to 20 URLs with failed_results), crawl, map, research with async get and streaming, usage, and logs. It also documents rate limits with 429/retry-after behavior and ships official Python and JS SDKs, and a probe confirmed an llms.txt index is live. Missing for 10: no machine-readable OpenAPI/Swagger spec was found at standard paths (all probes returned 404), and there is no independent hands-on corroboration beyond first-party docs and repos.
